returns_policy.title: Shipping and Returns Policy
returns_policy.intro: Free shipping across the Americas and Europe. You can withdraw from your purchase without giving a reason within the period your country's law grants you. If it arrives damaged or wrong, we replace it or refund you at no cost.
damaged_items: You can withdraw without giving a reason within your country's period, counted from delivery: 14 calendar days in the European Union, Norway and the United Kingdom; 10 in Argentina and Chile; 8 in Costa Rica and El Salvador; 7 in Brazil and Peru; 5 business days in Colombia, Mexico, Uruguay and Nicaragua; 3 in Ecuador. In other countries we honour the period set by your law.
To use it, fill in the “Withdraw from a purchase” form in the footer or write to us with your order number. We confirm receipt by email.
Send the product back within 14 days of telling us your decision, complete, with its accessories and tags.

We refund everything you paid, including the original shipping, within 14 days of receiving your withdrawal. Return shipping is paid by the customer, unless the applicable law places it on the seller.
not_accepted_items: If it arrives damaged or wrong, tell us within {hours} hours with photographs and we send the correct item at no cost or refund your money, your choice.
After that period you remain covered by the legal guarantee of your country and by the manufacturer's warranty.
Prices do not include your country's import taxes or duties: if customs charges them, they are paid by the recipient.
process_items: Withdraw with the form or report the issue through the channels at the end, with your order number.
We tell you the address and how to ship the return.
Once we receive and check the item, we process the refund or replacement.
cancellations_items: You can cancel the order before it is dispatched, with a full refund.
Once dispatched, you can still withdraw within your country's period, counted from when you receive it.
returns_policy.help: To start a return or ask about your order, contact us through either of these channels:

cookies.title: We use cookies
cookies.text: We use necessary cookies to run the store (cart, session, language and secure payment). With your permission we also use analytics cookies (Google Analytics) and marketing cookies (Meta and TikTok) to measure visits and show you relevant ads. You can change your choice anytime from the footer.
cookies.necessary_text: Cart, sign-in, language and payment fraud prevention (Stripe). Cannot be turned off.
cookies.analytics_text: Google Analytics: how many people visit the store and which pages they view.
cookies.marketing_text: Meta (Facebook and Instagram) and TikTok pixels: measure ads and show you personalized advertising. Turning this off means "Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information". If your browser sends a Global Privacy Control signal, we honor it automatically.
